headline: 🐧 Dirty Frag Linux Root, 🎓 Canvas Defaced, 🤖 ClaudeBleed Takeover, 🔥 PAN-OS KEV, 📦 Trellix RansomHouse, 🐛 Next.js Vuln Cluster
